vcu_g_0159_2000101a.name: app_state
vcu_g_0159_2000101a.description: Application state byte. app_set_state() stores the requested state here whenever it changes; vcu_alert_tone_sequencer switches on it, and vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count only counts while it is 0. The individual state codes are not named in the code.

vcu_g_0159_2000101c.name: app_state_substep
vcu_g_0159_2000101c.description: Sub-step counter of the current app state. app_set_state() clears it on every state change; vcu_alert_tone_sequencer counts it up and treats values above 50 (0x32) as the end of a step.

vcu_g_0159_20001034.name: variant_option_words
vcu_g_0159_20001034.description: Four 16-bit variant option words (word 0 at 0x20001034, word 1 at 0x20001036, word 2 at 0x20001038, word 3 at 0x2000103a). vcu_apply_variant_config builds them from the variant index in 0x20001fa7 with fixed per-variant masks and writes them back; word 0 is mirrored at 0x20001aea and words 1..3 at 0x20001b14..0x20001b18. Word 3 exists only in builds 152, 153 and 0159. The meaning of each bit is not named in the code.

vcu_g_0159_20001aea.name: variant_option0_shadow
vcu_g_0159_20001aea.description: Copy of variant option word 0 (0x20001034), made by vcu_apply_variant_config. can_get_tx_payload_for_id copies it into the static CAN payload buffer at 0x2000184c, so it is probably sent to the peer as part of a status frame.

vcu_g_0159_20001af2.name: status_flags_af2
vcu_g_0159_20001af2.description: 16-bit application status flag word. Bit 1 (0x0002) is set by the boot routine and tested by the PA6 output logic, bit 4 (0x0010) is tested by vcu_alarm_edge_trigger and vcu_periodic_100_tick_check, and bit 10 (0x0400) is tested by the main state machine. Meanings are inferred from usage only; timed-window and runtime-init code also read and write it.

vcu_g_0159_2000123e.name: main_state
vcu_g_0159_2000123e.description: Main operating state of the VCU, switched by vcu_0159_080047ac (cases 0..11 appear). Case 1 runs vcu_double_pulse_indicator_step, case 2 runs vcu_state2_periodic_tick, case 0 runs vcu_0159_0800a5c8. Written by the state handlers, the display renderer and the input actions; read by the PA6 output, the fault evaluation and the periodic check. Reset to 0 by the state machine on its change path.

vcu_g_0159_20001340.name: pa6_output_latch
vcu_g_0159_20001340.description: One-shot latch for the PA6 output path. vcu_pa6_output_status_update sets it to 1 when a request is accepted and clears it to 0 once the request has been consumed (probably a toggle request). Its address is also passed to vcu_pair_pulse_pattern_step.

vcu_g_0159_20001344.name: pair_pulse_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001344.description: Tick counter of the 60-tick two-output pulse pattern in vcu_pair_pulse_pattern_step. Reloaded to 60 (0x3c) when a pattern starts and cleared to 0 when it ends or is cancelled.

vcu_g_0159_20001348.name: pair_pulse_last_input
vcu_g_0159_20001348.description: Last sampled value of the pulse trigger input 0x20001fb5, kept for edge detection in vcu_pair_pulse_pattern_step. A pattern starts when the input differs from this value and the new value is non-zero.

vcu_g_0159_20001359.name: special_mode_gate_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001359.description: 0/1 flag of the special-mode gate (vcu_special_mode_gate): set to 1 when the gate step is entered and cleared when it is left. The gate also reads 0x2000135a, and the display uses 0x20001d04, a copy of the special-mode state.

vcu_g_0159_2000135a.name: special_mode_hold_flag
vcu_g_0159_2000135a.description: 0/1 hold flag of the special-mode gate, set to 1 and cleared inside vcu_special_mode_gate. The gate only enters special mode when this flag is set and bit 9 of status word 0x20001aee (mask 0x0040 after the shift test) is set, and the level value is above 4 (probably a latched 'hold active' flag).

vcu_g_0159_2000135b.name: state2_arm_flag
vcu_g_0159_2000135b.description: 0/1 flag set by vcu_state2_periodic_tick when the state-2 entry condition holds (no bit 0 in 0x20001f78, and the counter 0x20001b62 below 30) and cleared when that condition is lost; probably an armed latch for state 2.

vcu_g_0159_20001362.name: state2_step_count
vcu_g_0159_20001362.description: Counter of the state-2 tick. vcu_state2_periodic_tick increments it and tests it against 2; vcu_0159_080047ac clears it on every state change.

vcu_g_0159_20001364.name: special_mode_hold_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001364.description: Tick counter of the special-mode gate. Incremented each tick while the gate is active, cleared on exit, and the gate acts once it exceeds 299 (a 300-tick hold in vcu_special_mode_gate).

vcu_g_0159_20001366.name: special_mode_aux_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001366.description: Second tick counter of the special-mode gate. Incremented while the gate is active and cleared on exit; its threshold is 100 (probably the release or re-arm time). The u8 width is inferred from the 100-count limit.

vcu_g_0159_2000136a.name: state2_aee_bit7_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000136a.description: Previous value of bit 7 (mask 0x80) of status byte 0x20001aee, kept by vcu_state2_periodic_tick for edge detection: the transition fires when the bit becomes 0x80.

vcu_g_14a_200013a2.name: standby_timer_600_14a
vcu_g_14a_200013a2.description: Build 14a/148 counterpart of standby_quiet_ticks: the 600-tick quiet timer incremented by vcu_standby_entry_timer (decompiled 14a version tests it against 600). Cleared when it passes 600 or when the standby request flag is set.

vcu_g_0159_200013a4.name: standby_quiet_ticks
vcu_g_0159_200013a4.description: Quiet-tick counter of the standby entry in vcu_standby_entry_timer. Incremented each tick and cleared on activity; standby is entered once it exceeds 600 or the standby request flag 0x20001f70 is set. In build 14a the same role uses 0x200013a2.

vcu_g_14a_200013ae.name: standby_counter_100_14a
vcu_g_14a_200013ae.description: Build 14a/148 counter in vcu_standby_entry_timer: incremented, cleared when it exceeds 100 (0x64), and cleared on activity. The u8 width is inferred from the limit; its role is probably a debounce for the standby test.

vcu_g_0159_200013b0.name: standby_ramp_ticks
vcu_g_0159_200013b0.description: Ramp counter of the standby logic in vcu_standby_entry_timer. Counts up to 50 (0x32) while the standby condition holds and is cleared to 0 by the logic; the standby entry test also requires it to be 0 in the 14a build (probably a 50-tick settle time).

vcu_g_14a_200013b0.name: standby_ramp_ticks_14a
vcu_g_14a_200013b0.description: Build 14a/148 counterpart of standby_ramp_ticks: counts up to 50 (0x32) and down to 0, and the standby entry test requires it to be 0.

vcu_g_0159_2000148a.name: flag_word_shadow
vcu_g_0159_2000148a.description: Shadow copies of the three 16-bit flag words 0x20001ce0, 0x20001ce2 and 0x20001ce4 (one element each, in order). vcu_flag_bitmap_expand copies the live words here and expands their set bits into the item list (flag_list) when they change. A second shadow of the same words is flag_word_prev at 0x200022c8.

vcu_g_0159_200014da.name: level_hold_ticks
vcu_g_0159_200014da.description: Tick counter of vcu_level_hold_timer_update: counts while the scaled level stays at or above 60 and clears when it drops; sets flag 3 (0x20001c21 state) at 250 ticks and is capped at 299.

vcu_g_0159_200014e4.name: c14_c15_active_flag
vcu_g_0159_200014e4.description: 0/1 flag of the C14/C15 pulse sequencer (vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer). It is checked together with the request flags 0x20002022 and 0x20002023 and cleared when a sequence step is taken.

vcu_g_0159_200014e5.name: c14_c15_latch_flag
vcu_g_0159_200014e5.description: 0/1 latch of the C14/C15 sequencer: set to 1 in the step code and tested for non-zero before the next step; cleared when that step ends (probably 'pulse armed').

vcu_g_0159_200014e6.name: c14_c15_accumulator
vcu_g_0159_200014e6.description: Running sum of a signed 16-bit per-tick reading in vcu_c14_c15_pulse_sequencer. It is compared as (value >> 2) against 500 and cleared when the test fails, so it times a sustained condition (probably the sustained low analog reading named in the function's summary).

vcu_g_0159_200014e8.name: c14_c15_step_word
vcu_g_0159_200014e8.description: Second 16-bit accumulator of the C14/C15 sequencer, updated from a signed value plus its previous value and cleared at the end of the sequence. Its exact purpose is not determined.

vcu_g_0159_200014ea.name: c14_c15_count_a
vcu_g_0159_200014ea.description: Tick counter of the C14/C15 sequencer, incremented while the phase runs and cleared on reset. The sequence treats a value above 4 as reached (probably a count of pulses or edges).

vcu_g_0159_200014ec.name: c14_c15_count_b
vcu_g_0159_200014ec.description: Tick counter of the C14/C15 sequencer, incremented per tick and cleared on reset. Its limit is 40 (0x28), probably the duration of one output phase in ticks.

vcu_g_0159_200014ee.name: c14_c15_count_c
vcu_g_0159_200014ee.description: Second 40-tick (0x28) counter of the C14/C15 sequencer, with the same structure as c14_c15_count_b for the other output phase (probably).

vcu_g_148_200017cc.name: timed_window_schedule_word_148
vcu_g_148_200017cc.description: Build 148 counterpart of timed_window_schedule_word (0x2000188c in build 0159): the packed daily-window word built by the timed-window tick from the window start and end and the flag bits 22 and 23, sent through the frame helper FUN_0800c18c. Its address is passed to that helper.

vcu_g_0159_20001874.name: timed_window_armed
vcu_g_0159_20001874.description: 0/1 flag of the daily-window logic: set to 1 when a new window value is received (vcu_0159_080054ec) and cleared by vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick once the schedule word has been handled (probably a resend-pending flag). vcu_alarm_edge_trigger also takes its address.

vcu_g_0159_2000187a.name: timed_window_count
vcu_g_0159_2000187a.description: Counter of the daily-window logic: incremented each tick while 0x20001f48 is 0, and cleared after it passes 9, which gives a 10-tick debounce before a window change is sent (probably).

vcu_g_0159_2000187b.name: timed_window_input_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000187b.description: Previous value of bit 3 (mask 0x8) of status word 0x20001e6a, kept by vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick for edge detection.

vcu_g_0159_2000187c.name: schedule_bit22_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000187c.description: Cached copy of bit 22 of the schedule word 0x2000188c. When the live bit differs from this copy, the tick updates the copy and re-sends the schedule word.

vcu_g_0159_2000187d.name: schedule_bit23_prev
vcu_g_0159_2000187d.description: Cached copy of bit 23 of the schedule word 0x2000188c, with the same role as schedule_bit22_prev for the second flag bit.

vcu_g_0159_20001882.name: alarm_bit6_prev
vcu_g_0159_20001882.description: Previous value of bit 6 (mask 0x40) of status byte 0x20001e68, kept by vcu_alarm_edge_trigger to detect the rising edge that raises alert 4.

vcu_g_0159_20001884.name: timed_window_clock_snap
vcu_g_0159_20001884.description: Snapshot of the clock word 0x20001f40 (rx_clock_word) taken by vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick on each tick. Its hour field (bits 12..16) is compared with the window end hour.

vcu_g_0159_20001888.name: timed_window_wait_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001888.description: Counter of the daily-window logic: incremented each tick and tested against 30 (0x1e); cleared on reset. Probably the wait before the schedule word is re-sent.

vcu_g_0159_2000188c.name: timed_window_schedule_word
vcu_g_0159_2000188c.description: Packed daily-window word built by vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick from the active window start (0x20001b4a) and end (0x20001b4c) and the clock snapshot, then sent to the peer when it changes. vcu_0159_080054ec also passes its address to the sender. Probable layout from the shift and mask use: bits 0..5 start minute, bits 6..10 start hour, bits 11..16 end minute, bits 17..21 end hour, bit 22 and bit 23 window flags, bit 24 set on one path.

vcu_g_0159_20001890.name: timed_window_rx_start
vcu_g_0159_20001890.description: Window start time as received in a configuration record by vcu_0159_080054ec, packed like the schedule word (minute in bits 0..5, hour in bits 8..12). vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick copies it into the active start 0x20001b4a.

vcu_g_0159_20001892.name: timed_window_rx_end
vcu_g_0159_20001892.description: Window end time as received in the same configuration record as timed_window_rx_start, packed the same way. vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick copies it into the active end 0x20001b4c.

vcu_g_0159_20001ad4.name: serial_string
vcu_g_0159_20001ad4.description: 14-character unit serial/model code (ASCII, no terminator in RAM). vcu_0159_080054ec copies it from a configuration record, vcu_0159_08009da8 rewrites it from the built-in default at boot, vcu_serial_parse_variant_code reads the variant letter from its prefix, and vcu_serial_check_default and vcu_serial_match_set_flag compare it with the default. Address 0x20001ad5 is inside this string.

vcu_g_0159_20001b12.name: latch_flags_b
vcu_g_0159_20001b12.description: 16-bit flag word. Bit 1 (0x0002) is set by vcu_latch_event_flags_b, a one-shot that also sets bits 0..2 of 0x20001b32 and matching flags in 0x20001aee, 0x20001af0 and 0x20001af2. Tested by the PA6 output, the double-pulse indicator and the CAN payload builder; the boot routine also sets it.

vcu_g_0159_20001b14.name: variant_option_shadow
vcu_g_0159_20001b14.description: Shadow copies of variant option words 1..3, written by vcu_apply_variant_config in the same order: element 0 = option 1 (0x20001036), element 1 = option 2 (0x20001038), element 2 = option 3 (0x2000103a). The readers are not visible in this packet.

vcu_g_0159_20001b4a.name: timed_window_start
vcu_g_0159_20001b4a.description: Active daily-window start time, packed as minute in bits 0..5 and hour in bits 8..12. vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick copies it from timed_window_rx_start; vcu_runtime_defaults_init clears it to 0.

vcu_g_0159_20001b4c.name: timed_window_end
vcu_g_0159_20001b4c.description: Active daily-window end time, packed like timed_window_start. Its hour is the end test in vcu_timed_window_schedule_tick. vcu_runtime_defaults_init sets it to 0x0100 (hour 1, minute 0) at boot.

vcu_g_0159_20001b5e.name: rx_scaled_b5e
vcu_g_0159_20001b5e.description: Signed 16-bit value taken from a received frame by vcu_rx_frame_dispatch (payload field at byte 15) and divided by 10. It is copied to 0x20001d08 and 0x20001e62, and vcu_special_mode_gate tests it against 4 (probably a speed or throttle value in tenths).

vcu_g_153_20001b5e.name: pa6_gate_b5e_153
vcu_g_153_20001b5e.description: Variable at 0x20001b5e in builds 148, 14a, 14b, 14e, 14f, 152 and 153 (a different family from rx_scaled_b5e, which is the build 0159 meaning of that address). vcu_pa6_output_status_update reads it and vcu_runtime_defaults_init clears it; its purpose is not determined (probably a PA6 output gate). Width inferred.

vcu_g_0159_20001b6e.name: pa6_gate_b6e
vcu_g_0159_20001b6e.description: Flag in build 0159 only. vcu_pa6_output_status_update tests it (the output branch runs when it is 0), and vcu_runtime_defaults_init clears it at boot (probably a PA6 enable gate).

vcu_g_0159_20001ba6.name: settings_default_ba6
vcu_g_0159_20001ba6.description: Selector byte in build 0159 only. vcu_0159_08009da8 sets it to 2 when it is zero, and vcu_runtime_defaults_init sets it to 2 at boot. Its purpose is not determined.

vcu_g_0159_20001ba8.name: settings_default_ba8
vcu_g_0159_20001ba8.description: Selector byte in builds 14a and 0159. vcu_0159_08009da8 sets it to 2 when it is zero, and vcu_runtime_defaults_init sets it to 2 at boot. Its purpose is not determined; it has the same structure as settings_default_ba6.
